sentences.text: ORAL ORDER 1. RULE. Learned APP waives service of Rule on behalf of the respondent-State.

2. The present petition through jail has been preferred by the petitioner to release him on parole for a period of 30 days on the ground of filing an appeal against his conviction before the High Court of Gujarat.

3. Learned APP draws attention of this Court to the jail report to indicate that the petitioner has been convicted for offence under Sections 376, 363 and 366 of the IPC & Section 6 of the POCSO Act and the petitioner has undergone 04 years and 12 months sentence.
The jail report also indicates that the petitioner has never been released on bail.
Further, the jail conduct of the petitioner is reported to be good.

The petitioner is ordered to be enlarged on parole leave for a period of 7 (Seven) days from the date of his actual release on usual terms and conditions, including furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 5,000/- to the satisfaction of the jail authority.
The petitioner shall surrender before the jail authority on or before the expiry of the parole leave.
Registry to communicate this order through Fax to the concerned Jail Authority.
Rule is made absolute to the aforesaid extent.
